purpose: Straightforward everyday questions, not a complexity or adversarial benchmark
grading: First attempts only. Pass requires the main task answered correctly without unsupported facts or actions; partial for a useful but incomplete answer, failure for wrong/unhelpful answers, error for no final answer. Preserve original grades and report any later rerun separately.
